note: Trace form (research/trace-harness.md) for L10: the static twins, served by scripts/trace.sh against PostgreSQL at 1x and 10x. params turns on the app role's statement log (log_statement, in the trace database only), so each request's statements are read with their parameters, between two markers the harness logs around it; pg_stat_statements adds the blocks each statement touched. Judged on the two runs after the warm-up: the same read with the same parameters twice in one request with no write between (L10-2, L10-3); and, for a GET whose response carries no Cache-Control or ETag, the same read in every request whose blocks grow with the table while its rows do not, an aggregate (L10-1, info statically, which the trace resolves). defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other request is a decoy, in both twins.
